title: Agent Observer Feature
description: Session observer agent. Fork subprocess per session, SDK query() in worker, IPC buff back. Self-contained process manager — daemon unaware of workers.

ModelId.description: Claude model shorthand for observer agent

PermissionMode.description: SDK permissionMode — controls tool execution permission handling

SDKConfig.description: SDK query() options passed to agent-worker subprocess

maxTurnBudgetUsd.description: Max cost per SDK query turn. Default covers haiku 200K context.

allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Required when permissionMode is bypassPermissions. Safety flag.

allowedTools.description: SDK allowedTools — tools available to agent worker

timeoutMs.description: Kill worker if no IPC message within this time (ms)

systemPromptFile.description: Path to system prompt file (relative to agent feature dir)

buffPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to buff output for recursion guard identification

sdkSessionId.description: SDK session ID for resume. Null until first 'done' IPC.

pid.description: Worker process pid. Null if worker exited.

lastLine.description: Last read line in transcript JSONL

IPCMessage.description: Worker-to-daemon IPC message. Discriminated union on type field.

daemonOnly.description: Only run in daemon mode. Hook cold-start = no-op

execute.description: Feature interface. Sync return null. Async fire-and-forget _dispatch. Engine pipeline continues immediately.

collect.description:
Return unsent buff for session. Join text with 

---

. Mark sent + rewrite JSONL. Called via inject mode rule.

cleanup.description: No arg = kill all workers + clear all state. With sessionId = kill that worker + delete session/buff. Persist after.

init.description: Set daemon flag. Restore state from disk. Recovered sessions wait for next event (no auto-restart workers).

status.description: All session summaries. Includes child pid alive check via process.kill(pid, 0).

x-internal._dispatch: Spawn or restart worker. _children.has(sid) -> restart (fork new, kill old). Else -> spawn.
x-internal._forkWorker: fork('agent-worker.mjs', args, { detached, stdio: ['ignore','pipe','pipe','ipc'] }). child.on('message', _onMessage). child.on('exit', _onExit). child.unref(). _children.set(sid, child).
x-internal._killWorker: SIGTERM -> child.on('exit') auto cleanup. Timeout 3s -> SIGKILL.
x-internal._onMessage: IPC handler. IPCMessage discriminated union: buff -> _buff.push, done -> update session + _writeState, error -> log + cleanup.
x-internal._readState: Read logs/agent-state.json (sessions only, no buff). Corrupt -> { sessions: {} }.
x-internal._writeState: Atomic: writeFileSync(tmp) + renameSync(tmp, target). Sessions metadata only.
x-internal._readBuffFile: Parse JSONL lines → BuffEntry[]. Used by init to restore.
x-internal._writeBuffFile: Rewrite full JSONL (used after collect marks sent flags).
x-internal._appendBuff: Append single BuffEntry line (used on IPC buff receive).

x-subprocess.model: fork per agentId (same as restart-helper pattern)
x-subprocess.worker: agent-worker.mjs — parse args, build prompt, SDK query(), IPC out, exit
x-subprocess.lifecycle: fork -> IPC messages -> done/error -> exit. Daemon never touches workers.
x-subprocess.restart: fork new -> kill old (SIGTERM). Same session, fresh worker.
x-subprocess.isolation: Agent manages own _children Map. daemon.mjs unaware of agent workers.

stateContent.description: Session metadata only, no buff data

buffFiles.description: One JSONL file per session. Each line = BuffEntry JSON.

ts.description: Unix timestamp ms when IPC buff received

sent.description: true after collect() returns this entry

x-integration.features.mjs: Register: _registry.set('agent', fn). Expose: tree.agent, tree.collectAgent, tree.cleanupAgent, tree.agentStatus, tree.setAgentDaemonMode.
x-integration.engine.mjs: No direct agent calls. Agent trigger/inject controlled by rules via features.execute(rule.feature, event).

rules.trigger: stop-agent-observer.json — Stop event, feature.config.mode='trigger' → dispatch worker
rules.inject: userprompt-agent-drain.json — UserPromptSubmit, feature.config.mode='inject' → collect unsent buff → featureResult → handler additionalContext

x-integration.handler: UserPromptSubmit.mjs — featureResult string + config.mode='inject' → hso.additionalContext (not systemMessage)
x-integration.main.mjs: Agent worker (__HOOKS_AGENT_WORKER=1) bypasses daemon proxy → cold start → daemonOnly guard blocks dispatch (recursion prevention)

x-trigger.inject-rule: userprompt-agent-drain.json — UserPromptSubmit drains buff into context
x-trigger.description: Rule-based two-phase: Stop triggers analysis, UserPromptSubmit injects results. One event cycle delay.

x-docs.intent: Observer consciousness layer. Watches session transcripts, produces [ALERT]/[FEEDBACK]/[NOTE]/[STATS] analysis, injected as additionalContext.
x-docs.prompt: agent.md — W1-W6 workpoints, Init/Wake/Short workflows. Not in schema.
x-docs.recursion-guard: Prompt-level: agent.md instructs 'don't analyze other observers'. Buff inject prefixed with buffPrefix.
